declarations.description:
A month planner that draws events as bars across the days they cover: a vacation from the 10th to the 15th reads as
one strip, continued on the next row when it crosses a week. Overlapping events stack in separate lanes. Pass the
plan through `events` (a property, or a JSON attribute) with local-calendar `YYYY-MM-DD` dates, which never shift
across time zones. The header moves between months; `month` picks the one shown.

The month title opens a month picker (turn it off with `month-picker="false"`): a year stepper over the twelve
months, where a dot and a soft tint mark every month that has events. Arrow keys move between months, Page Up/Page Down change the year, Enter picks and Escape closes.

Below 480px of width the planner turns compact, as a phone calendar does: each day is its date over one dot per
event, a tap picks a day (arrow keys move between days) and that day's events are listed under the grid. It opens
on today, or on the 1st of another month.

Text follows `locale`, or the browser's language when it is not set: month and day names, "Today" and "this month"
come from `Intl`, and the navigation labels from a built-in list (English, French, German, Spanish, Italian,
Portuguese, Dutch, Vietnamese; other languages fall back to English).

members.name: selectedDay
members.description: Day picked in the compact layout, as `YYYY-MM-DD`; its events are listed under the grid.

members.name: pickerFocus
members.description: Month index (0–11) holding the picker's roving tab stop.

members.name: events
members.description: The plan: `{ id?, title, start, end?, color? }` entries with `YYYY-MM-DD` dates. Accepts a JSON string as an attribute.

members.name: month
members.description: Month shown, as `YYYY-MM`. Defaults to the current month; the header navigation updates it.

members.name: locale
members.description: Language of the planner's text, month and day names, e.g. `fr` or `en-GB`. Defaults to the browser's language.

members.name: weekStart
members.description: First day of the week. Defaults to the convention of `locale` (Sunday in `en-US`, Monday in `fr` or `en-GB`).

members.name: monthPicker
members.description: Makes the month title open a year and month picker. Set `month-picker="false"` for a plain title.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name for the planner; defaults to the month title.

members.name: firstWeekday
members.description: First day of the week as `Date#getDay` numbers it: `week-start` when set, else the locale's convention.

members.name: todayLabel
members.description: The Today button's label: "today" in the planner's language, capitalised.

members.name: markedMonths
members.description: `YYYY-MM` of every month an event touches.

members.name: datedEvents
members.description: Every event with valid dates, its end clamped to its start.

members.name: shownDay
members.description: The compact layout's selected day: the picked one while it is in the month shown, else today, else the 1st.

members.name: segmentsOf
members.description: Cuts every event that touches the week into one bar and stacks overlapping bars into lanes.

members.name: renderDaySelect

type.text: { event: MonthPlannerEvent; start: Date; end: Date }[]

members.description: The compact layout's day: a date in a circle over one dot per event (three at most), picking the listed day.

members.name: renderAgenda
members.description: The compact layout's list of the selected day's events.

events.name: month-change
events.description: Fired when the header navigation shows another month; `detail.month` is `YYYY-MM`.

events.name: event-click
events.description: Fired when an event bar is activated; `detail.event` is the entry from `events`.
